lcelection bihar
MLC Election 2026 ki 4 shikshak nirvachan kshetron (Patna, Darbhanga, Saran, Tirhut) ke natijon aur matganna se is vakt ki sabse bari rajnitik khabar samne aa rahi hai. bihar ke shikshak matdataon ne is bar abhutpurv aur aitihasik janadesh dete hue sabhi charon siting (nivartaman) shikshak MLC ummidvaron ko dhul chata di hai.
